summary: Pre-market, 2026-10-09. The composite stands at 50.76 in the caution band, -0.08 on the day and +0.20 over the week, inside an unchanged goldilocks regime at 0.9068 confidence. The last completed US session de-rated AI hardware: NVDA -2.9435, AVGO -4.3478, AMD -3.8987 and MU -4.7941, with the memory theme at -4.0819, quantum computing at -4.2547 and networking at -4.0299, after OpenAI's roughly 50 billion dollar annualised revenue disclosure was read as a demand warning. Mainland China's 2026-10-09 close extended the same direction: 8 of the 11 storage and semiconductor names we track closed lower, led by 300475.sz at -6.8216 and 000021.sz at -3.2911, while US equity futures pointed higher. The rate and volatility blocks still carry a 2026-10-07 vintage, 10Y at 5.28, 2Y at 4.77, the real rate at 2.92 and VIX at 15.08, so the composite has not yet absorbed the 2026-10-08 drawdown; that gap and the 2026-10-14 CPI print are the two things to watch.

top_risk_drivers.claim: AI hardware drove the last completed US session lower. NVDA closed at 230.479996, -2.9435; AVGO at 360.140015, -4.3478; AMD at 620.679993, -3.8987; MU at 1035.839966, -4.7941. Theme-level losses were concentrated in compute and storage: memory -4.0819, quantum computing -4.2547, networking -4.0299, semis -3.9961 and AI infrastructure -3.9467.

The trigger was a revenue disclosure rather than a demand collapse: OpenAI told investors it reached roughly 50 billion dollars of annualised revenue at the end of September, a figure analysts said was misread, and Nvidia-backed Firmus withdrew a planned listing citing market volatility.

The composite sits at 50.76 in the caution band, -0.08 on the day, +0.20 on the week and +6.59 over the month, with macro still the largest stress block at 71.16. The 10-year real rate at 2.92 and the 10-year nominal at 5.28 both sit at the 99.84 percentile.

Credit gave a split read rather than a uniformly tight one: HY OAS widened to 3.09 from 3.03 while IG OAS narrowed to 0.82 from 0.83, leaving the liquidity and credit block at 57.97 and trending down. HY OAS contributes 4.4376, the largest single input inside that block.

Balance-sheet liquidity moved in a supportive direction inside this layer: the Fed balance sheet rose to 6747560 from 6743031 and reserves to 3029659 from 2948090, while the Treasury General Account fell to 880253 from 948674, with reverse repo at 0.335.

supporting_signals.claim: Mainland China's 2026-10-09 close followed the same direction: 8 of the 11 storage and semiconductor names we track closed lower, led by 300475.sz at -6.8216, 000021.sz at -3.2911 and 603986.sh at -2.3744, with only 688825.sh at 0.9501, 688008.sh at 0.2995 and 600584.sh at 0.2236 advancing.
Crypto confirmed the risk-off tilt: BTC at 82505.0 printed -0.27726, ETH at 2495.58 printed -2.33001 and SOL at 109.97 printed -3.95424.
Cross-asset confirmation stands at 0.75, equal to 6 of the 8 production-scored signals triggering, with equity, dollar, real-rate, crypto and small-cap signals all aligned.

Equity structure deteriorated from the inside: the new-lows ratio rose to 0.1218, that is 19 of 156 names, against a new-highs ratio of 0.0192, or 3 of 156, while small-cap relative stood at -8.7372 and the block score rose to 52.07.
Two macro inputs remain flagged on the risk side: the dollar index at 121.3848 and the 10-year real rate at 2.92, with the dollar easing only marginally from 121.7882.

contradicting_signals.claim: The weakness is hardware-specific rather than complex-wide: AI software printed 0.8584, digital advertising 0.724, robotics 0.675, fintech 0.2356 and gaming 0.185, while internet platforms -0.1794, enterprise software -0.2276, cybersecurity -0.3472 and cloud computing -0.3748 held far better than the -3.9467 to -4.2547 range in hardware.

The consumer electronics reading of 9.7211 is not a broad electronics rally: it is the 2026-10-09 Hong Kong close of a single Asian constituent inside a basket whose US members still reflect the 2026-10-08 session.

The rate and volatility inputs did not advance with the equities: 10-year at 5.28, 2-year at 4.77, the real rate at 2.92, EFFR at 3.88 and VIX at 15.08 all carry a 2026-10-07 vintage, so part of the composite's calm is a vintage artefact.
The single largest contribution in the model, 7.5 from cross-asset confirmation, is a neutral contribution: the indicator's risk score is pinned at 50.0 even though its value moved to 0.75.

Reverse repo at 0.335 enters the composite at a 95.35 risk score and a 3.814 contribution, but that mapping comes from the indicator's neutral direction setting rather than from a stress observation: a near-zero reverse repo balance is not by itself a widening risk premium.

what_changed_today: The composite edged -0.08 to 50.76 and stays in the caution band, with +0.20 on the week and +6.59 over the month.
The last completed US session de-rated AI hardware rather than software, so the drawdown stayed concentrated in compute and storage.
Mainland China's 2026-10-09 close was broadly lower across the storage and semiconductor panel, with 8 of 11 names down and 300475.sz the weakest at -6.8216.
Delta Air Lines missed at 1.72 against a forecast of 1.77 and cut its 2026 outlook on a fuel-cost surge, with the shares indicated lower pre-market.
Breakevens eased inside this layer: 5-year fell to 2.33 from 2.35 and 10-year to 2.35 from 2.36.
The Fed balance sheet rose to 6747560 from 6743031 and reserves to 3029659 from 2948090 as the Treasury General Account was drawn down to 880253 from 948674.
The implied policy path nudged to 4.075 from 4.065 and still reads as a hike against a delivered EFFR of 3.88.

Policy was active on both sides: the CPC Central Committee and the State Council issued the new quality productive forces opinion encouraging foreign venture capital, and the securities regulator published a draft revision of the public fund operation rules.
US equity futures pointed higher pre-market per press reports, suggesting the AI-hardware leg may stabilise before the cash open.
watch_next: US CPI on 2026-10-14 is the next high-importance macro print and the cleanest test of whether the policy path stays priced as a hike.
The US bank earnings cluster on 2026-10-13, including JPM, C, GS, WFC, JNJ and UNH, opens third-quarter reporting.
TSM reports on 2026-10-15 alongside PPI and advance retail sales, all inside the next 7 days.
Whether the 2026-10-08 equity drawdown finally registers in the rate and volatility blocks once their vintage advances past 2026-10-07.
Whether the AI-hardware de-rating broadens into credit, where HY OAS at 3.09 is the largest single contributor inside liquidity and credit.
Whether the mainland China storage complex extends its 2026-10-09 losses or stabilises on the policy support for new quality productive forces.
Whether the hike priced at 4.075 against an EFFR of 3.88 survives the 2026-10-14 inflation print.
The airline read-through from Delta's fuel-cost warning, with UAL on 2026-10-20 and AAL on 2026-10-22.

bull_case.title: Bull case: a hardware-only de-rating the broader complex absorbs
points: Tech verticals away from compute and storage held: AI software printed 0.8584, robotics 0.675 and digital advertising 0.724.
Volatility did not confirm: VIX at 15.08 sits at the 23.57 percentile and realized volatility at 10.1898 keeps the volatility block at 17.59.
The regime is still goldilocks at a confidence of 0.9068, and breadth above the 200-day moving average held at 0.5742.
The composite moved only -0.08 on the day and +0.20 on the week, so the drawdown has not yet registered at the index level.

base_case.title: Base case: an AI-hardware de-rating inside an intact goldilocks regime
points: The composite holds at 50.76 in the caution band, -0.08 on the day but +6.59 over the month.
Macro remains the largest stress block at 71.16, with the 10-year real rate at 2.92 and the 10-year nominal at 5.28 both at the 99.84 percentile.
Credit is mixed rather than stressed: HY OAS widened to 3.09 from 3.03 while IG OAS narrowed to 0.82 from 0.83.
The mainland China panel closed lower on 2026-10-09 with 8 of 11 names down and 300475.sz at -6.8216, keeping the CN leg aligned with, but smaller than, the US move.

bear_case.title: Bear case: the de-rating extends into liquidity and credit stress
points: Cross-asset confirmation is already 0.75, equal to 6 of the 8 production-scored signals, with the dollar index at 121.3848 and the real rate at 2.92 both flagged.
Internal deterioration is already visible: the new-lows ratio at 0.1218, or 19 of 156 names, dwarfs the new-highs ratio at 0.0192, or 3 of 156.
Small caps at -8.7372 and semis at -5.6207 are both scored at a flat 50.0, so any calibration that activates those inputs would push the composite higher.
HY OAS at 3.09 already carries the largest contribution inside liquidity and credit at 4.4376, so further widening has an outsized effect on the composite.
